subject: Future Tech
title: Fusion for Space Propulsion
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Fusion for Space Propulsion.

hook.text: A chemical rocket takes 7 months to reach Mars. A fusion-powered engine could do it in 30 days.

buildup.text: Fusion produces far more energy per gram than chemical fuel. A fusion engine would have enormous thrust and efficiency.

discovery.text: NASA is funding fusion propulsion research.

twist.text: Fusion engines don't exist yet, but the physics is sound.

climax.text: Fusion propulsion could open the outer solar system.

punchline.text: Fusion in space turns planets into neighbors.

quiz.question: How fast could fusion propulsion reach Mars?
